overview_description.description: Cactus provides an AI-powered business assistant designed to manage administrative tasks and streamline operations. The platform qualifies new leads based on predefined criteria, follows up automatically, and ensures timely engagement with potential clients. It offers a personalized, fully branded website without coding requirements, enabling businesses to maintain a distinct online presence. It also handles scheduling and coordination, managing calendars, sending reminders, and overseeing daily tasks to maintain smooth operations. Its AI conducts natural, context-aware conversations, scoring leads, and detecting spam while responding instantly to calls and messages. The system operates continuously, allowing businesses to remain responsive and connected regardless of location. IT adapts to various industries, including salons, real estate, and service-based businesses, providing tailored communication and support.
